title.en: When Multiple-Unicast Feasibility Is Equivalent to Single-Sink Routability
title.zh: 多单播可行性何时等价于单汇可路由性

summary.en: We show that when the maximum flow between every pair of distinct destinations is at least the total demand rate, multiple-unicast coding and fractional routing are equivalent in feasibility to routing all source rates to any fixed destination. This yields a maximum-flow algorithm for deciding feasibility and proves the Langberg–Médard conjecture as a corollary.
summary.zh: 我们证明，若任意两个不同目的节点之间的最大流不小于总需求速率，则多单播编码、分数路由与将所有源速率同时路由至任一固定目的节点在可行性上等价。由此得到基于最大流的可行性判定算法，并将 Langberg–Médard 猜想作为推论证明。

title.en: Undirected Network Coding and Faster External-Memory Integer Sorting
title.zh: 无向网络编码与更快的外存整数排序

summary.en: We study the advantage of network coding over fractional routing in undirected networks and use the construction to develop faster external-memory integer sorting algorithms.
summary.zh: 我们研究网络编码相对于分数路由在无向网络中的优势，并利用这一构造设计更快的外存整数排序算法。

title.en: On the Multiple-Unicast Conjecture: Beyond Cut Metrics
title.zh: 多单播猜想：超越割度量

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Li Que, Zongpeng Li, Baochun Li

summary.en: We develop a unified metric framework for comparing network coding and routing, proving their equivalence for new classes of undirected networks.
summary.zh: 我们建立了比较网络编码与路由的统一度量框架，并在若干新的无向网络类别中证明二者等价。

title.en: A Session Interaction Framework for The Multiple-Unicast Conjecture
title.zh: 多单播猜想的会话交互框架

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Zongpeng Li, Xiying Fan, Haifeng Chen

summary.en: We develop a **Session Interaction Framework** that combines session dominance and session decoupling to reduce the analysis of network coding and routing to irreducible cores and independent subsets.
summary.zh: 我们提出**会话交互框架**，结合会话支配与会话解耦，将网络编码与路由的分析归约到不可约核心和独立子集。

title.en: On the Multiple-Unicast Conjecture: Session Dominance

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Yeqiao Hou, Jessie Hui Wang, Zongpeng Li

summary.en: We introduce a **session dominance** framework: if the conjecture holds for a particular set of sessions, it also holds for another, dominated set.
summary.zh: 我们提出**会话支配框架**：若猜想对某一组会话成立，那么对被其支配的另一组会话也成立。

title.en: Space Information Flow: Multiple Unicast in $l_p^n$
title.zh: 空间信息流：$l_p^n$ 空间中的多单播

summary.en: We show that network coding is equivalent to routing in $l_p^n$ spaces for $1 \leq p \leq 2$.
summary.zh: 我们证明，当 $1 \leq p \leq 2$ 时，网络编码与路由在 $l_p^n$ 空间中等价。

title.en: FitFEC: A Multi-Scale Transformer for Optimizing Packet Loss Recovery
title.zh: FitFEC：用于优化丢包恢复的多尺度 Transformer

publications.authors: Yining Li, **Sirui Liu**, Zongpeng Li, Liang Du, Ling Deng

biography: I am currently a Ph.D. candidate at the Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, Tsinghua University, advised by Professor Zongpeng Li. I received my bachelor’s degree from the School of Software, Tsinghua University.

My research focuses on network coding and the multiple-unicast problem. I am also interested in forward error correction and connections between network coding, algorithms, and computational complexity.

en.footer: Network coding, algorithms, and the ideas that connect them.
overviewParagraphs: My research asks when combining messages inside a network can outperform routing, and when routing alone is sufficient. I focus on multiple-unicast communication in undirected networks, where independent messages must reach their prescribed destinations.

My work develops theoretical tools for analyzing multiple-unicast networks through session structure and metric structure. At the session level, I study dominance and interaction among sessions, together with reductions and decompositions of session sets. At the metric level, I develop a framework that goes beyond cut constraints to study the relationship between network coding and routing. I also explore connections between network coding, algorithms, and computational complexity, including external-memory integer sorting.

biography: 我目前在清华大学网络科学与网络空间研究院攻读博士学位，导师为 Zongpeng Li 教授。本科毕业于清华大学软件学院。
我的研究主要围绕网络编码与多单播问题展开，同时关注前向纠错，以及网络编码与算法、计算复杂性之间的联系。

zh.footer: 探索网络编码、算法，以及它们之间的联系。
overviewParagraphs: 我的研究围绕一个核心问题展开：在网络内部对消息进行编码，何时能够优于路由，何时仅靠路由就已足够？我主要关注无向网络中的多单播通信，即将相互独立的消息分别传输到各自指定的目的节点。
我的工作主要围绕会话结构与度量结构展开，发展分析多单播网络的理论工具。在会话层面，我研究会话之间的支配与交互关系，以及会话集合的化简与分解；在度量层面，我建立超越割约束的分析框架，用于研究网络编码与路由的关系。我也探索网络编码与算法及计算复杂性的联系，包括外存整数排序问题。
